name: Biology
overview: Scripture reveals that all living creatures, from the moving creatures in the waters and birds in the sky to mankind, were created by God with intentionality and purpose. Man holds a unique place in creation, made in the very image and likeness of God, and endowed with dominion over all other living beings. The formation of man from the dust and the impartation of life through God's breath underscores the intimate and sovereign role of God as Creator of biological life. Even the care given to purity laws, such as the burning of garments with leprosy, reflects God's concern for the order and holiness within His creation.
